ENGLISH: CLDR (the Common Locale Data Repository) is a global database created by the Unicode Consortium, a not-for-profit global organization. CLDR helps computers work correctly in different languages. It includes things like the names of months and days, date and number formats, and other language rules that phones, websites, and apps rely on. In practice, the only way for most modern software to support a language properly is for that language to be included in CLDR. CLDR is the largest and most comprehensive shared database of language and regional information available today.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: CLDR (ny Common Locale Data Repository) dia tobin’angondrakitra iraisam-pirenena iray noforonin’ny Unicode Consortium, fikambanana iraisam-pirenena tsy itadiavam-bola iray. CLDR dia manampy ireo solosaina hiasa araka ny tokony ho izy amin’ny teny maro samihafa. Izy io dia miaty zavatra toy ireo anaran’ireo volana sy andro, fiendrika daty sy isa, ary fitsipi-teny hafa izay iankinan’ireo telefaonina sy tranonkala ary app. Amin’ny fampiharana, ny fomba tokana ahafahan’ny ankamaroan’ireo rindrambaiko maoderina mandray an-tanana ny teny iray araka ny tokony ho izy dia ny fisian’io teny io ao amin’ny CLDR. CLDR dia ilay tobin’angondrakitry ny fampahalalana momba ny teny sy ny faritra itambarana lehibe indrindra sy mahafaobe indrindra misy ankehitriny.

ENGLISH: Anyone can view CLDR data, but improving it and adding to it is a detailed process. Two times each year, volunteers and language experts can propose new translations, fix mistakes, discuss disagreements, and vote on what best represents real language use. They can also add new languages to CLDR, helping their languages become part of the digital age.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Na iza na iza dia afaka mijery angondrakitra CDLR, saingy misy fizotra antsipiriany kosa ny fanatsarana azy sy ny fanampiana zavatra aminy. Indroa isan-taona, ireo mpilatsaka an-tsitrapo sy mpahay teny manokana dia afaka mandroso dikanteny vaovao, manitsy ireo diso, miady hevitra momba ireo tsy fitovian-kevitra ary mandatsa-bato hifidianana izay maneho tsara indrindra ny fampiasan-teny tena izy. Afaka manampy teny ao amin’ny CLDR, manampy ny tenim-pirenen’izy ireo ho lasa anatin’ny vanim-potoana nomerika ihany koa izy ireo.

ENGLISH: Instead of decisions being made by a small group behind closed doors, CLDR is shaped through open discussion and review. After several stages of checking and approval, the final data is released and used by billions of devices and applications around the world.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: CLDR dia volavolaina amin’ny alalan’ny adihevitra sy fandinihana misokatra, fa tsy fanapahan-kevitra ataona vondron’olom-bitsy ao an’efitra mikatom-baravarana. Aorian’ny ambaratonga fanamarinana sy fankatoavana maromaro, dia avoaka sy ampiasain’ny fitaovan-tserasera sy rindranasa an-tapitrisany eran’izao tontolo izao ilay angondrakitra farany.

ENGLISH: Translations in the Unicode Common Locale Data Repository are collected and managed through an online platform called the Survey Tool. This tool lets people view language data, suggest new translations or corrections, see what others have submitted, and discuss differences to reach agreement. During each submission period, contributors—including members of the Unicode Consortium, organizations, and the general public—are invited to review data for their languages and regions and propose updates. These updates can range from small wording changes to adding support for languages that are entirely new to the repository. Instead of a small group deciding everything in private, the tool lets many contributors discuss and vote, so the data reflects real language use. After several review stages, the approved information becomes part of the CLDR database, which is used by millions of phones, websites, and apps worldwide.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Ireo dikanteny ao amin’ny Unicode Common Locale Data Repository dia angonina sy tantanana amin’ny alalan’ny vovonana an-jotra iray antsoina hoe Fitaovana Fitsapan-kevitra. Ity fitaovana ity dia ahafahan’ny olona mijery angondraki-teny, mandroso dikanteny vaovao na fanitsiana, mahita izay naroson’ny hafa, ary miady hevitra momba ireo fahasamihafana mba hahatongavana amin’ny marimaritra iraisana. Mandritra ny vanim-potoana fandrosoana tsirairay, ireo mpandrotsaka—anisan’izany ireo mpikambana ao amin’ny Unicode Consortium, ireo fikambanana ary ny besinimaro ankapobeny—dia asaina handinika angondrakitra momba ireo teny sy faritr’izy ireo ary hanolotra fanavaozana. Toy izay vondron’olom-bitsy manapa-kevitra manokana momba ny zava-drehetra, ilay fitaovana kosa dia mamela mpandrotsaka maro hiady hevitra sy hifidy, ka ahitana taratra ny tena fampiasana ilay teny ilay angondrakitra. Aorian’ny ambaratongam-pandinihana maromaro, ny fampahalalana nankatoavina dia lasa ampahan’ny tobin'angondrakitra CLDR izay ampiasain’ny telefaonina sy tranonkala ary app an-tapitrisany eran-tany.

ENGLISH: MokBlok helps people check whether their translations make sense when used in real apps. Language data often looks correct in a list but causes problems when displayed in calendars, menus, or interfaces.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: MokBlok dia manampy ny olona hanamarina raha misy dikany na tsia ny dikantenin’izy ireo rehefa ampiasaina anatin’ireo app tena izy. Matetika ny angondraki-teny dia toa marina ao anatin’ny lisitra iray saingy miteraka olana rehefa aseho anatin’ireo kalandrie, menio na interifasy.

ENGLISH: MokBlok takes translation data and automatically places it into realistic app screens, such as calendars or health apps. Contributors can see exactly how their language appears and quickly spot mistakes or awkward phrasing.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: MokBlok dia maka angondraki-dikanteny sy mametraka izany amin’ny fomba mandeha ho azy ao anatina efijerin’app toa ara-javamisy, toy ireo tetiandro na ireo appm-pahasalamana. Ireo mpandrotsaka dia afaka mahita marina ny fomba isehoan’ny tenin’izy ireo sy mahatsikaritra haingana ireo diso na ireo firafitra fehezanteny mikaviavia.

ENGLISH: MokBlok also provides examples of how other languages are used in digital interfaces. This is especially helpful for designers working with languages that are rarely supported and lack design references.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: MokBlok ihany koa dia manome ohatra hoe ahoana ny fomba ampiasana ireo tenim-pirenena hafa anatin’ireo interifasy nomerika. Izany dia manampy manokana ho an’ireo mpanefibika miasa amin’ireo tenim-pirenena izay raisina an-tanana mahalana sy tsy ampy fanahaka enti-mampahatsiahy ara-tefibika.

ENGLISH: MokBlok makes it easier to review language data visually, instead of relying only on tables or text lists.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: MokBlok dia manamora ny fandinihana angondraki-teny ara-pijery, fa tsy miankina amin’ireo tabilao na lisi-dahatsoratra fotsiny.

ENGLISH: SILICON Practitioners Program – Call for Proposals
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Fandaharanasan'ny Mpikatroka SILICON - Antso ho an'ny Tolokevitra

ENGLISH: The SILICON Practitioners Program supports practitioners working to expand the digital presence of underrepresented languages. This program provides small grants to individuals with concrete, impact-driven projects that advance language inclusion across digital systems. Practitioners are supported by SILICON, a Stanford-based initiative focused on building durable, community-centered language infrastructure.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Ny Fandaharanasan'ny Mpikatroka SILICON dia mandray an-tanana ireo mpikatroka miasa amin’ny fanitarana ny fisiana ara-nomerikan’ireo teny latsa-danja ara-panehoana. Ity fandaharanasa ity dia manome vatsy kely ireo olon-tsotra manana tetikasa azo tsapain-tanana sy taritim-piantraika izay mampandroso ny fampiatian-teny eran’ireo rafitra nomerika. Ireo mpikatroka dia tohanan’ny SILICON, finiavana iray manana foibe ao Stanford izay mifantoka amin’ny fanorenana fotodrafitrasan-teny mifototra amin’ny fiombonambe.

ENGLISH: The program is designed for people who are already doing the work or are ready to begin. Whether you are launching a new project, unblocking stalled progress, or bringing an existing effort to completion, the Practitioners Program offers funding, visibility, and institutional support to help move your work forward.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Ilay fandaharanasa dia natao ho an’ny olona efa manao ny asa na vonona hanomboka. Na manomboka tetikasa iray vaovao na tsia ianao, manala sakana amin’ny fandrosoana mikatso na mitondra ny ezaka iray efa misy ho amin’ny fahavitany, ny Fandaharanasan’ny Mpikatroka dia manolotra famatsiam-bola sy fahitana ary tohana avy amina sampandraharaha hanampiana amin’ny fampandrosoana ny asanao.

ENGLISH: SILICON invites applications from a wide range of practitioners, including keyboard and app designers, linguistics, type designers, language ethnographers, OCR and machine learning specialists, large language model researchers, and others working at the intersection of language, design, and technology. Projects may focus on one or more living or historic Digitally Disadvantaged Languages and should demonstrate clear goals, measurable progress, and real-world applicability.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: SILICON dia manasa fangatahana avy amin’ny karazana mpikatroka maro samihafa, anisan’izany ireo mpanefibikan’ny marobokotra sy app, mpahaiteny, mpanefy bikan-tsoratra, mpahay tenim-poko, mpahaimanokana fianarana-masinina sy Famantarana Masitsoratra Optika (OCR), mpikaroka momba ny modelin-teny lehibe (LLM), sy ny hafa miasa eo amin’ny teboka fihaonan’ny teny sy tefibika ary teknolojia. Ireo tetikasa dia mety ho mifantoka amin’ny Teny Mahantra Ara-nomerika velona na ara-tantara iray na maromaro ary tokony hampiseho tanjona mazava sy fandrosoana azo refesina ary fahafaha-mampihatra amin’ny tontolo tena izy.

The Donald Knuth & Charles Bigelow Type Design Incubator (KBI), run by SILICON at Stanford University, supports designers working with underrepresented and endangered writing systems.

ENGLISH: LexRay is a tool designed by SILICON (Stanford University) to make it easier to contribute language data to the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR), the open database maintained by the Not-For-Profit global organization, Unicode.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: LexRay dia fitaovana iray novolavolain’ny SILICON (Oniversite Stanford) hanamorana ny fandrotsahana angondraki-teny ao amin’ny Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR), ilay tobin’angondrakitra misokatra kojakojain’ny fikambanana iraisam-pirenena Tsy Itadiavam-Bola, Unicode.

ENGLISH: When a phone in the United States shows a date like “November 12,” this is all thanks to CLDR data, which is the only way that computers and phones know how that date should appear in different languages and regions. In Spanish, for example, the same date becomes “12 de noviembre.” Different word order, different structure, same meaning. CLDR encodes these patterns so operating systems, apps, and websites can localize content correctly worldwide.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Rehefa mampiseho daty iray toy ny “12 Novambra” ny telefaonina iray ao Etazonia, izany rehetra izany dia noho ny angondrakitra CLDR, izay fomba tokana ahafantaran’ireo solosaina sy telefaonina fa tokony hiseho amin’ny teny sy faritra maro samihafa io daty io. Amin’ny teny Espaniola, io daty io ihany dia lasa hoe “12 de noviembre”. Filaharam-boanteny samy hafa, firafitra samy hafa, dikany samy hafa. Manao soramiafina ireo verimberintoetra ireo ny CLDR , amin’izay ireo rafitra mpanodina sy ireo app ary ireo tranonkala afaka mandika votoaty am-pahamarinana amin’ny teny eo an-toerana eran’izao tontolo izao.

ENGLISH: Out of roughly 7,000 human languages, the vast majority are not included in the CLDR database. Adding a language to the CLDR is therefore not just a technical step—it is a foundational act of empowering language communities to participate in the digital age.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Amin’ireo tenin’olombelona sahabo ho 7.000, ny ankamaroany dia tsy ao anatin’ny tobin’angondrakitra CLDR. Ka tsy dingana ara-tekinika fotsiny, araka izany, ny fanampiana ny teny iray ao amin’ny CLDR, fa fihetsika fototra hampahefana ireo fiombonambe ara-teny handray anjara amin’ny vanim-potoana nomerika.

ENGLISH: But working with the CLDR can be difficult, however. Beyond speaking your mother tongue, you must also understand CLDR “patterns” (such as "d 'de' MMMM" which is the pattern for "12 de noviembre" mentioned above). This technical requirement is often a major barrier.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Saingy mety ho sarotra ny miara-miasa amin’ny CLDR, na izany aza. Ankoatra ny fitenenana ny tenin-dreninao, dia tsy maintsy mahazo ireo “verimberintoetra” CLDR  (toy ny "d 'de' MMMM" izay verimberintoetra ho an’ny "12 de noviembre" voatonona etsy ambony) ihany koa ianao. Ity fitakiana ara-tekinika ity matetika no sakana lehibe.

ENGLISH: LexRay removes this obstacle. Instead of having to learn CLDR patterns, LexRay lets you work entirely in your language. You simply write in regular dates—such as “12 de noviembre”—and LexRay generates the correct CLDR pattern automatically.

Ny tapakila CLDR rehetra dia azo aroso ao amin’ny tranonkala fanarahan-dia raharahan’ny Unicode (antsoina hoe Jira):

https://unicode-org.atlassian.net/projects/CLDR/

ENGLISH:
How to File a Ticket (Step by Step)

Log in to Jira

You must have a Jira account to file a ticket.

If you do not already have one, you can request a Jira account from the site.

Click “Create”

Once logged in, click the red “Create” button at the top of the page.

This opens a form for submitting your ticket.

Describe the problem or request

Clearly explain what is wrong or what needs to be changed in CLDR.

Include examples if possible (for example, how something should appear in your language).

Choose a component
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE:
Ahoana no fandrosoana tapakila (dingana tsirairay)

Midira ao amin’ny Jira

Tsy maintsy manana kaonty Jira iray ianao vao afaka mandroso tapakila.

Raha mbola tsy manana ianao dia afaka mangataka kaonty Jira iray amin’ilay tranonkala.

Tsindrio “Mamorona”

Raha vao tafiditra, tsindrio ilay bokotra “Mamorona” eo amin’ny fanambonin’ny pejy.

Manokatra fisy iray handrosoana ny tapakilanao io.

Soritsorito ilay olana na fangatahana

Hazavao tsara hoe inona no tsy mety na inona no mila ovaina ao amin’ny CLDR.

Asio ohatra raha azo atao (ohatra, ahoana no tokony ho fisehon’ny zavatra iray amin’ny teninao).

Misafidiana singa iray

ENGLISH:
You will be asked to assign a component (the part of CLDR your issue relates to).

If you are unsure which one to choose, simply select “unknown.” This is acceptable.

Submit the ticket

After filling out the form, submit it.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE:
Hasaina manendry singa iray (ilay ampahan’ny CLDR mifandraika amin’ny raharahanao) ianao.

Raha tsy azonao antoka hoe iza no hofidiana, dia fanteno fotsiny “tsy fantatra”. Azo ekena io.

Arosoy ilay tapakila

Aorian’ny famenoana ilay fisy, dia arosoy io.

ENGLISH: Your ticket will now be visible to the CLDR team and other contributors.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Hiharihary amin’ny ekipa CLDR sy ireo mpandrotsaka hafa amin’izay ilay tapakilanao.

ENGLISH: Once submitted, your ticket becomes part of the official CLDR review process, where it can be discussed, clarified, and—if appropriate—used to improve how your language is handled in Unicode CLDR.
TRANSLATION IN YOUR LANGUAGE: Raha vao aroso dia lasa ampahan’ny fizotram-pandinihana CLDR ofisialy ilay tapakila, ao izy no ho azo iadian-kevitra, hazavaina ary, raha mety, ampiasaina hanatsarana ny fomba ikirakirana ny teninao ao amin’ny Unicode CLDR.
